Linux system-library copyright and license index

The notices below cover system libraries used directly or through other
libraries, including desktop and graphics modules where available.
These libraries are supplied by the operating system, not by this UI package.

Entries identify the reference package versions for each notice. Installed
versions can differ; the listed versions are not installation requirements.
A shared notice file is referenced when several packages carry identical
copyright and license text.

The original package notices are reproduced unchanged. Some also describe
utilities, tests, documentation or build tools from the same upstream project;
their inclusion does not mean those files are part of DIA-NN.
Full texts referenced as /usr/share/common-licenses/... are supplied in
../license-texts/ as well. Installed-package notices remain applicable.

System libraries and modules vary with the distribution, graphics driver,
desktop theme and input method. The index includes the reference desktop
modules and Mesa graphics libraries; other installed providers retain their
own notices and terms supplied by the operating-system or driver vendor.
DIA-NN does not distribute those providers.
